items.quote: For some, it’s family. For others, it’s career, passion, or personal growth.

items.quote: True freedom begins when you always have at least three options—where to work, what to do, and how to live.
items.statement: True freedom begins when you always have at least three options—where to work, what to do, and how to live.

items.quote: Success isn’t just financial stability. It’s reaching a place where you choose your work not out of necessity, but because you love it.
items.statement: Success isn’t just financial stability. It’s reaching a place where you choose your work not out of necessity, but because you love it.

items.quote: So today, on Women’s Day, I ask: What does freedom mean to you?
items.statement: Consider what freedom means to you.

items.quote: Women have fought hard for the right to make their own choices.
